original_test_intent.statement: Run the project-specified NVIDIA GEMM workload and compare its measured performance with the approved reference while observing GPU health.

The planned long-run timing and performance comparison.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run the Approved NVIDIA GEMM Performance Workload
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the exact project GEMM recipe on the specified GPU scope and determine whether performance and health meet its signed reference.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Owner-named NVIDIA GPU model/topology with pinned driver, CUDA, cuBLAS and benchmark build.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the GPU set and GEMM datatype/dimensions/layout/iterations stated by the SPEC; no inferred SGEMM substitute.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SPEC revision, stable GPU UUID/BDF list, binary provenance/hash, complete GEMM parameters, warm-up/repetition/runtime policy, clock/power policy, expected GFLOPS or time and tolerance, monitoring limits and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Collect read-only identity/health first. After approval, run the verified binary with the exact recipe for its declared duration, preserving every invocation and result; do not clear baseline logs.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Recipe, binary, target mapping, idle window, thermal/power headroom, OOB monitoring and stop/recovery plan are approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: SPEC revision; GPU UUID/BDF/topology; driver/CUDA/cuBLAS/binary versions and hash; exact commands, parameters, timestamps, iterations and raw performance; clocks/power/temperature/ECC/XID plus kernel/BMC deltas.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Only the signed recipe threshold/tolerance. Actual values may be collected before disposition, but absence of the reference prevents PASS.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not invent dimensions/datatype/reference, target GPUs by unstable index, clear logs, change clocks/power or run an unbounded load.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: GPU owner approves recipe, package and long compute window; engineer makes final disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent can inventory and execute a supplied recipe; owner defines the workload and judges anomalies.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop load, preserve partial output, return GPUs to idle, verify GPU/driver/thermal/power health and use approved recovery for persistent faults.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Missing or inconsistent recipe, target or binary; thermal/power/ECC/XID/AER anomaly; hang, timeout, device loss or incomplete evidence.

identified_defects: Source has no executable workload or acceptance rule.
reason_for_change: A missing owner recipe prevents present execution and PASS, but it does not make a well-defined future GEMM run technically non-automatable.
removed_ambiguities: No generic GEMM substitution is permitted.
Actual collection is separated from PASS disposition.
resolved_blockers: Capability is no longer mislabeled BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: All recipe and acceptance details remain owner-supplied.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 keeps the same no-guess safety boundary while correctly representing the missing SPEC as readiness inputs and preserving an executable, evidence-complete path once those inputs arrive.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently preserved owner-defined datatype/dimensions/layout/iterations, stable GPU scope, bounded duration, reference-before-PASS and health stop gates.
